svg.title: Food allergen analysis workflow — current implementation
svg.desc: All modes use local OCR, rule-based ingredient and statement extraction, and dictionary matching. The default path directly displays the report. Optional AI checks pending ingredients per selected allergen, with cloud LLM batching and single-ingredient local AI or Decisions requests. The label report is displayed and saved before an independent optional cloud vision check. The front photo and selected allergens are sent to the vision model. Separate reminders leave the label report unchanged.

text.tspan: Current implementation · Local OCR, optional AI and cloud photo reminders
Scores and photo reminders do not confirm allergen presence.
